0022600192.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (7-2) host the Washington Wizards (4-5) in the Thunder's 10th game of the 2026-27 season, riding a three-game winning streak, a 4-0 home record, and a 2nd-place finish in the Northwest. Washington, on a two-game losing streak, is 8th in the East and 1.5 games back in 2nd in the Southeast, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 132-111 win in Washington on March 21, 2026. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Jaylin Williams (back, spasms), Nikola Topic (back) and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Washington is missing Anthony Davis (ankle, sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve).
